how_to_run: For each scenario, check out `base` in an isolated worktree and give the developer the issue body as it stood at `base`'s commit date; do not supply issue or PR comments written after that date.
The baseline is `baseline_head`: the head the original developer pushed for first review without this skill. The skill run starts from `base` with the skill loaded and the same issue body.

A grader who has not seen SKILL.md scores both heads against `expected_behavior` and `process` from the code and tests only. A narrative that claims a check without code or test evidence scores nothing.
Compare first-review defects, uncovered required behaviour and elapsed time.

scenarios.query: Issue 78: mount text editors with safe draft restoration and reconnect recovery. The page can disconnect and reconnect while a storage read or reload is in flight; input typed during the read must not be lost.
expected_behavior: Input typed while a read is in flight survives the read's completion
A valid saved draft is still restored when nothing was typed
A read result started before a disconnect cannot change state after the reconnect
Coverage, existing or extended or new, runs a disconnect between the start and the completion of a read, and the change states what that coverage cannot establish
process: The interleavings disconnect, reconnect, destroy and new input were traced against each in-flight read before the handlers were written
Redundant state that can disagree was removed; independent facts may stay in separate fields

scenarios.query: Issue 62: validate uploaded images with an external parser process under a capacity limit and store one recoverable attempt.
expected_behavior: A missing or crashed parser runtime is reported and logged as an operational failure, distinct from an invalid image
When the caller exits, the capacity slot is released only after the parser process has terminated
The whole request has one composed bound derived from the per-file limits
process: The existing pool or process-supervision mechanism was named and checked before any custom one was written, with the verified limit if it was rejected

scenarios.query: Issue 62, same run as scenario 2: the image parser probe from issue 244 (scripts/image_parser_probe at base) is replaced by application code and deleted.
expected_behavior: Each malformed-input regression the probe checked (CRC-only corruption, missing trailer, later oversized frame, duplicate or late animation control chunks) has a surviving application test, or the gap is named
Functions, fields and comments the replacement leaves unused are removed
process: The probe's historical report is not cited as regression coverage
